description: All medications and treatments on record for a condition, in five fixed sections: approved medicines (regulatory records only, by country or region), documented off-label use, herbs/supplements, in development, and recruiting clinical trials. Every row carries a citation and source locator. This is a lookup of sourced records, never a recommendation. Sourced from OpenRemedies, which draws on national medicines registers and the ClinicalTrials.gov registry plus herbal and supplement monographs; call get_coverage for the current list of registers and jurisdictions.
